experiment_metadata.reason: Scratch 4v1 mixed-coverage line combining the current default ingredients: K10 capture-to-coverage delay, hard boundary/death, boundary/entity proximity safety, and speed-only coverage settled success.
experiment_metadata.boundary_semantics: All scenes use hard boundary/death. Touching boundary or any collision gives collision_penalty=-160; near-boundary clearance<4m gives boundary_proximity_penalty=-10/step; entity/obstacle clearance<d_safe gives emergency_penalty=-10/step.
experiment_metadata.optimizer_semantics: 2M scratch, lr 1e-4 then 3e-5 at 1M, epsilon 0.6 to 0.05 over 1M.
experiment_metadata.is_pursuing_semantics: coverage-to-capture is immediate; capture-to-coverage remains effective capture for exactly ten action transitions. Observation, reward, hold, and replay all use the effective role.
experiment_metadata.safety_update_20260714: collision_penalty=-160; entity/obstacle proximity emergency_penalty=-10 per step at d_safe; hard-boundary proximity penalty=-10 per step inside 4m; boundary_penalty is set to -160 for clarity but remains unused by hard/death boundary mode.
experiment_metadata.coverage_supplement: Uses the existing voradj_mixed_coverage schedule, four replay buffers, and recovery_pure coverage supplement.
experiment_metadata.coverage_speed_semantics: Coverage/post-capture success keeps geometry and settled metrics separate; motion success is speed-only: max_speed<=0.30, accel/turn are logged but not required.

experiment_metadata.new_speed_shaping_20260715: Latest scratch 4v1 mix 2M after speed shaping change: K10, hard boundary/death, boundary proximity warning, four-buffer mixed coverage/pure recovery, hard gate, old motion penalty disabled, linear +5..+15 speed shaping, +20/+240 on speed success.
experiment_metadata.training_start_seed_control: uses the same seed as A2Scratch-2M to reduce initialization confounding where possible
experiment_metadata.a3_changes_vs_a2scratch: single scratch line based on A2 4v1 config, with APF-v2_fixed explicitly enabled and voradj.center_sqrt_n_normalization_enabled=true
experiment_metadata.supervisor: tools/supervise_a3_curriculum.py; checks every 100k from 500k and selects historical best after 2M
experiment_metadata.selection_extra_metric: capture scenario avg_steps is included as a tie-breaker so faster capture is preferred after success/settle/collision criteria
experiment_metadata.device_decision: Run A3 on cuda:1 per user request; this shares GPU1 with the active CenterSqrtN curriculum.
experiment_metadata.release_scope: Final integrated CR-MS + VCT-LS + CE configuration; no intermediate experiment config is required.

experiment_metadata.replay_unit: joint transition; optimizer unit is focal-agent item
experiment_metadata.formal_entry_contract: ladder YAML, central critic only, AW action mode
experiment_metadata.capture_semantics: legacy VorAdj all-entity sites, adjacency visibility, APF-v2_fixed, approach=1, old-MS=2, front=0.5
experiment_metadata.coverage_semantics: CE centroid-energy with free-mask coverage geometry
experiment_metadata.phase_semantics: K10 smooths temporary adjacency loss while an enemy remains; after all enemies are captured the role switches directly to coverage
experiment_metadata.episode_mix: capture_only; no pure_ce and no post_capture transitions
experiment_metadata.replay_mix: uniform over stored joint transitions; role metadata is diagnostics-only
experiment_metadata.diagnostic_signals: capture rate, detection rate/step, initial/final/min enemy distance and progress, CE progress
experiment_metadata.storage_semantics: model at every 25k; only latest replay remains resumable; final bundle is full
experiment_metadata.resource_placement: cuda:0; independent P1 artifact and no checkpoint warm start
experiment_metadata.observability: corrected Legacy-VorAdj local enemy sensing; no global enemy broadcast
experiment_metadata.sole_cf2_delta: global enemy broadcast true to false; Legacy support role and 1.0 capture_task + 1.0 coverage unchanged
experiment_metadata.role_contract: corrected K10 effective task_label/reward_role remain unchanged; B dense reward uses a separate current-observability direct/informed/uninformed partition
experiment_metadata.task_objective: CAPTURE only; role labels are reward-observability diagnostics, not separate tasks
experiment_metadata.dense_reward_contract: direct capture gets approach+mean_shift+front; one-hop informed gets approach only; uninformed gets zero dense task reward
experiment_metadata.terminal_reward_contract: each formal normal/stationary capture reward is shared once with every active pursuer
experiment_metadata.forbidden_reward_paths: no coverage reward; no coverage PBRS; no oracle dense reward for uninformed pursuers
experiment_metadata.checkpoint_diagnostics: every 25k; deterministic 20-rollout capture probe plus geometry/collision/role/reward decomposition
experiment_metadata.duration_contract: train through 200k; 100k is diagnostic only and never an early-stop gate
experiment_metadata.k10_contract: corrected K10 effective pursuing state retained as the strict CF3 task-level control
experiment_metadata.paired_ablation: same seed and full resolved contract as B1 except K10 release delay and execution GPU
experiment_metadata.migration_contract: corrected Pure-Capture K10 synchronized-swept local Legacy-VorAdj
experiment_metadata.hypothesis: Strict legacy IQN decision-feature parity plus conservative MAPPO removes representation and optimizer confounds.
experiment_metadata.only_changed_variable: IQN distributional value learning is replaced by categorical MAPPO with a centralized action-free V critic.
experiment_metadata.actor_contract: scratch LegacyVorAdjFeatureBackbone followed by categorical logits[9]
experiment_metadata.gate_contract: three seeds, 400k each, formal evaluation every 25k; no early failure at 50k
